# @arnaud-zg/configs

> Shareable dev-tooling configs (ESLint, Prettier, tsconfig, tsdown, Lefthook, remark, commitlint)
> published to npm as @arnaud-zg/configs, and a Claude Code plugin marketplace named arnaud-zg whose
> plugin hexagonal-skill-builder lints Agent Skills (SKILL.md).

## hexagonal-skill-builder: a linter for Agent Skills

A linter and writing guide for Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders loaded by Claude Code and other coding
agents). It checks four rules, named, small, resolves and tested, and prints the file, line and fix
for each finding. Node only, no dependencies, no network, read-only. MIT.

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/configs`
- Install in any agent: `npx skills add arnaud-zg/configs --skill hexagonal-skill-builder`
- Call it: `/arnaud-zg:hexagonal-skill-builder check`, or ask the agent to "check the skills"
- Run it without an agent: `node <skill folder>/scripts/check.mjs [path ...] [--suite <script>] [--json]`

- [README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/README.md): what it is, install, the four rules, questions
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/tutorial.md): a first skill, checked
- [How-to guides](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/how-to.md): CI, commit hooks, JSON output, splitting a long entry
- [Reference](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/reference.md): command, exit codes, what each rule looks for
- [Explanation](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/docs/explanation.md): why a skill's shape is its behaviour
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/configs/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/skills/hexagonal-skill-builder/SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows
